The '''Siola system''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Siolan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="ImperialCommando" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Siola system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
